# stalwart_sieve_system_script (Data Source)

Defines a system Sieve script executed by the server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object. Set either `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the script

### Read-Only

- `contents` (String) Content of the script
- `description` (String) Description of the script
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the script is active
